title: QR payment pressure
summary: A QR code is presented as a way to receive money or fix an account.
scenario: Scanning the code would open a payment flow or send money to an unexpected destination.
warning_signs: The sender says scanning is required to receive a refund
The amount or recipient is hidden until late in the flow
safe_actions: Do not scan an unexpected code
Check the payment direction and recipient before any approval
Verify the request through a known channel
recovery_guidance: Contact the payment provider if a payment was sent
Keep the code, receipt, and timestamps
reporting_guidance: Preserve the original image or message
Use a reporting destination only after checking it
prevention_tips: A QR code is a link, not proof of identity
Use known payment flows for refunds
false_positive_notes: A legitimate QR code can still be replaced or misdirected; inspect the final payment details.
